sloka: सा अहम् गौर् इव सिम्हेन विवत्सा वत्सला कृता ।कैकेय्या पुरुष व्याघ्र बाल वत्सा इव गौर् बलात् ॥२-४३-१८॥
transliteration: sā aham gaur iva simhena vivatsā vatsalā kṛtā ।kaikeyyā puruṣa vyāghra bāla vatsā iva gaur balāt ॥2-43-18॥

translations.english: O best of men I have been forcibly separated from my affectionate son by Kaikeyi just like a cow from its calf by a lion.
